AgentLiquidityMarketplaceV62.calculateInterest(uint256,uint256,uint256) (contracts/core/AgentLiquidityMarketplaceV62.sol#1162-1170) performs a multiplication on the result of a division:
	- annualInterest = (principal * annualRateBPS) / 10000 (contracts/core/AgentLiquidityMarketplaceV62.sol#1167)
	- interest = (annualInterest * durationSeconds) / 31536000 (contracts/core/AgentLiquidityMarketplaceV62.sol#1168)

ReputationManagerV4.recordLoanCompletion(address,uint256,uint256,bool,uint256) (contracts/core/ReputationManagerV4.sol#414-482) performs a multiplication on the result of a division:
